title: With all seven metric columns hidden the five always-on columns and the grand Totals still render — not an empty state
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the report with data.
custom_steps:
1. Hide all seven metric columns.
2. Read the table and the grand Totals indicator.
custom_expected:
1. The table still renders the five always-on columns (Date, Invoice, Customer, Status, Subtotal) and the grand Totals indicator.
2. No empty or error state is shown.
